name: Meredith Ms B
bio: Meredith 'Ms B' brings a captivating mix of rhythmic spoken word and soul-infused vocal delivery. Known for exploring themes of personal identity, resilience, and urban modern life in Botswana, her performances create an intimate bond with the audience.

name: AMB. Dr. Ophadile T Gofhamodimo
bio: Dr. Ophadile T Gofhamodimo is a global peace ambassador, cultural leader, and founder of The Urge Promotions. Her poetry focuses on leadership, community empowerment, spiritual depth, and the resilience of the human spirit.

name: Mbali Bloom
bio: Mbali Bloom weaves vivid narratives drawn from rich southern African traditions and modern youth experiences. Her expressive stage delivery blends lyrical poetry with subtle vocal harmonies.

name: George Extra
bio: George Extra combines smooth R&B vocals with live acoustic arrangements. His performances bring romantic, heartfelt melodies that elevate the open-mic atmosphere.

name: Phodiso Modirwa
bio: Phodiso Modirwa is an internationally published Motswana poet and writer, author of 'Speaking In Code' and resident of the International Writing Program. Her poetry explores vulnerability, identity, memory, and social observation.

name: Soulstress
bio: Living up to her stage moniker, Soulstress delivers powerful, emotion-packed vocal performances rooted in jazz and neo-soul, exploring themes of healing, love, and self-discovery.

name: Tony-T
bio: Tony-T sits at the intersection of conscious street poetry and classic hip-hop cadence. His fast-paced rhythm and sharp commentary address social realities and youth culture.

name: Thekalatswene poet bw 🐒
bio: Celebrated for preserving cultural heritage through verse, Thekalatswene poet bw blends traditional Setswana praise poetry with modern, witty stage banter and energetic delivery.

name: BENZEPOET
bio: BENZEPOET delivers energetic and raw commentary on modern relationships, ambition, and life in Gaborone. His sharp delivery makes him an audience favorite.

name: Alfred wa katara 🇧🇼
bio: Alfred wa Katara combines spoken word poetry with soulful acoustic guitar ('katara'). Known for his warm, humorous storytelling and social commentary, he honors Botswana's acoustic traditions.

name: Bubbles
bio: Bubbles brings vibrant energy and soulful melodies to the stage. Her lighthearted yet deep vocal performances touch on romantic themes and joyful living.

name: Kalprit Jones
bio: Kalprit Jones explores abstract themes, existential thought, and emotional resonance through rhythm-driven spoken word, challenging traditional verse structures.

name: BekiFeels
bio: BekiFeels creates atmospheric soundscapes paired with vulnerable lyricism. Her music dives deep into themes of personal growth, love, and introspective emotion.

name: Motshwarateu
bio: Motshwarateu is a master of traditional Setswana praise poetry (*leboko*). With command over metaphor and cultural idioms, his performances evoke pride, ancestral memory, and nationhood.

name: Britney kakuru
bio: Britney Kakuru captures the dreams, struggles, and voices of the younger generation. Her expressive stage presence mixes spoken word with subtle melodic undertones.

name: twenty1secrets
bio: twenty1secrets delivers introspective, layered poetry exploring hidden emotions, mental wellness, and personal truths that are rarely voiced aloud.

name: Tlharantlhope!!!
bio: Known for dramatic flair and uninhibited stage presence, Tlharantlhope!!! brings intense emotional range, dynamic movement, and bold social critiques to the stage.

name: P.J Mophuting
bio: P.J Mophuting crafts reflective, story-driven poetry that paints rich character portraits and explores everyday human interactions across Botswana.

name: Ms Jay
bio: Ms Jay commands the stage with smooth, velvet-like vocals and acoustic accompaniment, sharing stories of womanhood, resilience, and romantic beauty.

name: Caroline Nonhle
bio: Caroline Nonhle delivers punchy, thought-provoking slam poetry centered around gender equity, empowerment, and self-love.

name: Poetess Kayen
bio: Poetess Kayen brings a soulful, ancestral voice to the stage, celebrating heritage, womanhood, and community harmony through rhythm-infused verse.

name: Paris Kamodi
bio: Paris Kamodi blends indie pop sensibilities with contemporary Afro-R&B, captivating crowds with melodic hooks and charismatic stage energy.

name: Loyiso
bio: Closing out the night, Loyiso delivers a grounded, soulful combination of spoken poetry and live vocal improvisation, leaving a lasting impression on the audience.
